declaration.preface:
Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd recognizes the pressing need for sustainable procurement practices in the composite manufacturing industry. As a company committed to environmental stewardship and social responsibility, we understand the pivotal role procurement plays in achieving sustainability goals. Our procurement policy aims to align with standards and best practices, fostering a supply chain that prioritizes environmental conservation, ethical sourcing, and community well-being.

At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we believe that sustainable procurement is not just a choice, but a responsibility. By integrating sustainability principles into our procurement processes, we strive to minimize the environmental impact of our operations, promote fair labor practices across our supply chain, and contribute positively to the communities in which we operate. This policy reflects our dedication to creating a more sustainable future while maintaining the high standards of quality and performance that our customers expect from us.
declaration.declaration: At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are committed to integrating sustainability into every aspect of our procurement process. We prioritize sourcing materials and services from environmentally responsible suppliers, promoting ethical labour practices, and fostering innovation to minimize our ecological footprint while maximizing long-term value for all stakeholders.
declaration.scope: This policy is exclusively applicable to the operations of Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, covering all employees, workers, subcontractors, and other stakeholders directly affiliated with our site.

Environmental Issues: Raw material sourcing: Prioritize suppliers with sustainable practices, minimizing environmental impact from extraction, transportation, and processing of composite materials.
Innovation and Research: Invest in research and development of sustainable materials and processes to continuously improve environmental performance and competitiveness.
Emphasize the selection of supplier’s compliance with environmental regulations and promoting responsible production methods.
Bio-based Innovation: Promote the use of bio-based resins and recycled materials in composite fabrication, fostering innovation for more sustainable product offerings.
Supply Chain Eco-Footprint: Mandate suppliers to adhere to eco-friendly practices in raw material extraction, such as ensuring minimal environmental impact throughout the supply chain.
Certification Criteria: Implement stringent criteria for supplier selection, prioritizing those with certifications like ISO 14001.
Labor Practice and Human Rights: Supplier vetting: Ensure all partners comply with labour laws and uphold human rights.
Safe working conditions: Demand adherence to safety standards to protect employees' well-being.
Fair wages: Mandate fair compensation for all workers across the composite manufacturing supply chain.
Fair Labor Standards: Implement fair labor practices across the supply chain, ensuring adequate wages, reasonable working hours, and respect for human rights principles.
Supplier Collaboration: Collaborate with suppliers to enforce ethical labor standards, promoting fair wages, safe working conditions, and safeguarding workers' rights.
Monitoring and Enforcement: Monitor and address labor rights violations within the supply chain, prioritizing fair treatment, non-discrimination, and adherence to international labor standards.
Education and Training: Educate suppliers and employees on labor rights and responsibilities, fostering a culture of respect, equity, and dignity in the workplace.

policy.monitoring:
At Indutch Composites Technology Pvt Ltd, we are committed to promoting sustainability throughout our procurement practices. To enhance our understanding of our current position and identify areas for improvement, we have established a comprehensive reporting framework. This framework encompasses the following key elements:

Conduct thorough supplier assessments: Evaluate suppliers based on their sustainability policies, practices, and certifications.

Prioritize partnerships with certified sustainable suppliers: Give preference to suppliers with recognized sustainability certifications, such as ISO 14001 or Fair Trade.

Ensure fair labour practices: Require suppliers to comply with international labor standards and provide fair wages and working conditions for their employees.

Conduct regular audits: Perform periodic audits of suppliers to verify compliance with ethical sourcing standards and identify areas for improvement.

Assess lifecycle environmental impact: Evaluate the environmental footprint of products and materials throughout their lifecycle, considering factors such as raw material extraction, manufacturing processes, transportation, and end-of-life disposal.

Implement eco-friendly packaging: opt for packaging materials that are recyclable, biodegradable, or made from renewable resources to reduce packaging waste.

Source eco-friendly materials: Prioritize the procurement of materials that are sustainably sourced, renewable, or recycled.

Consider product durability and recyclability: Select products that are durable, repairable, and designed for easy disassembly and recycling at the end of their lifecycle.

Require supplier transparency: Request detailed information from suppliers regarding the origin of raw materials, manufacturing processes, and environmental performance.

Implement traceability systems: Utilize blockchain or other traceability technologies to track and trace the journey of products throughout the supply chain, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Set sustainability targets: Establish clear targets for key sustainability metrics, such as carbon emissions reduction, waste diversion, and energy efficiency improvements.

Conduct regular performance reviews: Monitor progress towards sustainability goals and identify areas where additional efforts are needed to drive continuous improvement.

Collaborate with suppliers: Engage with suppliers to share best practices, collaborate on sustainability initiatives, and address common challenges.

Educate and involve employees: Provide training and awareness programs to educate employees about sustainable procurement practices and involve them in decision-making processes related to sustainability.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Chief Compliance Officer at Indutch Pvt Ltd is responsible for the implementation, oversight, and review of this policy. The Sustainable Procurement Policy will be reviewed annually, and any updates will be communicated as necessary.
